items.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022
items.q: I cannot listen Coltrane because it’s like taking over caffeinated myself... I hear these things, I analyze, I just discover

ctx.x: If you know what I mean. © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

Yeah it’s just kind of like you feel at home in a certain way. But you know I just — like it depends also the mood, because there are some times that I cannot listen Coltrane because it’s like taking over caffeinated myself. You know I wouldn’t be able to relax on a Coltrane CD because my mind goes on kind of not working but you know I hear these things, I analyze, I just discover — oh I didn’t notice that he was doing that. So to me it’s just like, it’s not a way to relax. So sometimes even if I put like Tibetan…
Were your parents, did they contribute to your musical career? Did they want you or force you to take piano lessons?
